_comment: Release notes for 1.1.5 (versionCode 8, 2026-11-14). Same locale keys as 03e.

notes.en:
Film Camela 1.1.5
• If prices can't be loaded from the store, the MY tab now says why and offers Try again
• Small fixes
notes.ko:
Film Camela 1.1.5
• 스토어에서 가격을 못 불러오면 MY 탭에 이유와 '다시 시도'가 보여요
• 자잘한 문제를 고쳤어요
notes.ja:
Film Camela 1.1.5
• ストアから価格を読み込めないとき、MYタブに理由と「再試行」を表示します

Film Camela 1.1.5

Film Camela 1.1.5

Film Camela 1.1.5
